# Klavrio

Klavrio is a privacy-focused keyboard-layout correction utility for Windows 10/11 and macOS 13 or later.

It corrects text typed with the wrong physical keyboard layout. Users can enable conservative automatic correction for recognized words or select existing text in another desktop application and convert it with a configurable global shortcut.

Supported interface languages and keyboard layouts: English, Hebrew, Arabic, Russian, German, and French.

Text correction runs locally. Klavrio does not require an account and does not send typed or selected text to a cloud translation service. Optional software and community-dictionary update checks use HTTPS metadata; update requests do not contain the user's text.

Official website: https://klavrio.app/
Official source repository: https://github.com/OnyxDeveploment/Klavrio
Releases: https://github.com/OnyxDeveploment/Klavrio/releases
